# 2 Baruch Chapter 59 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**59:1** "And-after-this came-the-second-bright-waters which-you-saw; these-are-the-fountain-of-Moses, and-of-Joshua his-son, and-of-all-those-like-them."

**59:2** "For-at-that-time the-lamp-of-the-eternal-law which-endures-forever and-ever illuminated-all-those-who-sat-in-darkness, which-announced-to-those-who-believed-the-promise-of-their-reward, and-gave-hope-to-those-who-were-doubting, and-trust-to-those-who-sinned."

**59:3** "For-the-holy-tabernacle was-prepared, and-the-beginning-of-the-priesthood was-established, and-the-law was-given, and-the-altar was-prepared."

**59:4** "And-the-sacrifices were-offered upon-it; and-the-offerings-of-the-firstfruits were-presented; and-the-incense-offerings were-burned; and-the-holy-fire was-kindled; and-the-righteous-king was-elected."

**59:5** "And-the-light-of-the-law enlightened-those-who-sat-in-darkness, and-it-announced-the-eternal-covenant to-those-who-were-in-the-wilderness."

**59:6** "And-in-those-days the-hidden-manna came-down from-heaven, and-the-holy-vessels-of-gold and-silver and-the-vessels-of-the-Levites were-prepared."

**59:7** "And-the-Tent-of-Meeting was-erected; and-the-cherubim-of-glory shaded-the-mercy-seat; and-there-was-established the-tabernacle-of-the-HOLY-ONE, and-his-Name was-called upon-it."

**59:8** "These-are-the-bright-waters which-you-saw."

**59:9** "For-the-commandment-of-the-law-was-given which-will-never-pass-away, and-the-signs-of-the-holy-people were-made-to-shine,"

**59:10** "and-the-bright-cloud, which-was-going-before-the-people of-God, enlightened-those-who-were-walking-in-darkness."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
